scope: Seven new restaurant records for tourist meal planning in western, northern and southern Odisha, prioritising named standalone restaurants and explicit vegetarian options.

reuse_before_research.method: Read research map and restaurant research query during initial city expansion; re-read restaurants.json before this second batch to exclude existing venues.
reuse_before_research.missing_fields: Standalone options, vegetarian meals, concrete menus and visitor-use details in underrepresented cities.

venues.name: Kedia’s Restaurant
venues.description: A standalone restaurant serving Indian, Chinese and tandoor dishes, with biryani and pizza also listed on its website.
venues.visitor_note: The website separates Kedia’s Restaurant from Dhaba by Kedia’s. Use the Budharaja restaurant contact when planning your visit.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: Yavis Restaurant
venues.area: Firewood Depot, near CT Market, Sector 4
venues.description: A restaurant with Indian, Chinese and Continental choices, including vegetarian and meat dishes, thali lunches, pizza and Lebanese items.
venues.visitor_note: Browse the itemised online menu and use the website’s table-booking option for a group meal.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: The Marinated
venues.description: A standalone restaurant listing biryanis, mutton kadhai, chicken dishes and paneer lasuni tikka.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists separate lunch and dinner service. Contact the restaurant for current availability before making a special trip.

venues.name: Bojanam
venues.area: First floor, City Palace Building, Bijipur Main Road, near Christian Hospital
venues.description: A vegetarian South Indian restaurant serving dosas, idlis, banana-leaf thalis and filter coffee.
venues.visitor_note: The restaurant is on the first floor and advertises two- and four-wheeler parking. Ask about step-free access if needed; its menu also offers Jain and no-onion, no-garlic preparations on request.
venues.menu_note: Operator menu; availability and prices may change.

venues.name: Yum Chinese
venues.area: O.T. Road, opposite Ori-Plast, near Laxmi Narayan Temple, Alupur
venues.description: An O.T. Road restaurant listing noodles, fried rice, crispy chilli baby corn and chicken dishes.
venues.visitor_note: The website provides a direct number for delivery and bulk orders, alongside its menu link.

venues.name: Super Snax at Mayfair Oasis
venues.description: A vegetarian restaurant serving South Indian food and snacks, including dosa and chaat, at Mayfair Oasis.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists both indoor and outdoor seating. Use the hotel front-office contact to confirm restaurant access and current service.

venues.name: VDumpling Dynasty — Cuttack
venues.description: The Cuttack outlet of a locally founded momo and Pan-Asian food business, with dumplings, noodles, fried rice and soups on its menu.
venues.visitor_note: The operator lists the Cuttack branch in Sector 9, CDA. Its published contact serves the brand; confirm this outlet’s seating and service before visiting.

observed_facts: Homepage identifies Kedia’s Restaurant at Main Road, Budharaja, Sambalpur, with Indian, Chinese and tandoor cooking.
Operator menu page separates Kedia’s and Dhaba by Kedia’s; their telephone numbers differ.
limitations: Menu page retrieved; dish-list images were not transcribed. No rooftop or private-dining claim is transferred from the separately named Dhaba outlet.
Testimonials and operator superlatives are not used as independent evidence.

observed_facts: Homepage provides named menu categories and items, including vegetarian and non-vegetarian choices, and a table reservation link.
Contact page gives Firewood Depot, near CT Market, Sector 4, Rourkela 769002 and the displayed telephone number.
limitations: The contact page has unusual near-24-hour schedule entries; opening hours are deliberately not copied.
Reservation function was observed but not tested or submitted.

observed_facts: Homepage lists specific biryani, chicken, mutton and paneer dishes.
Address is Amrita Complex, Bombay Chowk, Jharsuguda 768203; operator publishes a direct phone and separate lunch/dinner service.
limitations: Operator information, not an independent quality or accessibility assessment. No visit or booking completed.

observed_facts: Homepage describes a vegetarian South Indian restaurant at City Palace Building on Bijipur Main Road, Berhampur 760001.
Homepage states first-floor location and parking; menu lists Jain/no-onion/no-garlic preparations on request.
Menu explicitly includes dosas, idlis, banana-leaf thali, vegetarian biryani and filter coffee.
limitations: Parking is an operator claim. A lift, wheelchair access and parking capacity were not verified.
Ratings, cleanliness promises, route distances, prices and travel times are not reproduced.

observed_facts: Homepage lists named dishes, direct delivery telephone and a bulk-order service.
Operator address is O.T. Road opposite Ori-Plast Ltd, near Laxmi Narayan Temple, Alupur, Balasore 756001.
limitations: No price, hygiene or quality claims copied. Dining-room details and ice-cream claims appeared only in testimonials and are not asserted.

observed_facts: Restaurant page explicitly categorises Super Snax as pure vegetarian, South Indian food and snacks.
Operator describes indoor and outdoor seating, gives the Durlaga address, and labels +91 9124752320 as its front-office number.
limitations: Pure-vegetarian description applies to this named outlet, not every restaurant in the resort.
Public restaurant access for non-residents was not separately confirmed.

observed_facts: Indexed operator homepage identifies a Cuttack outlet at Sector 9, CDA, postcode 753014.
Operator lists momo, dim sum, noodles, fried rice and thukpa, and publishes a brand-level ordering number.
limitations: Initial extraction returned no lines. Subsequent live browser read of homepage verified menu, Cuttack Sector9 address and brand contact after automatic browser check completed.
Seating and Cuttack-specific opening hours were not established; no awards, rankings or first-in-Odisha claim repeated.

coverage_gaps.note: No sufficiently established direct operator restaurant source was found in bounded fresh searches. Hotel Sri, The Sans and Labanya Bhawan remain leads from third-party material; do not fill the public directory with guessed URLs.

excluded_matches.name: Gollden Saffron, Cuttack
excluded_matches.reason: Operator-style page retrieved but generic templated content and stock-photo testimonials warrant identity/contact corroboration before adding it as a visitor recommendation.

policy: Direct operator links only; no Tripadvisor links. Operator descriptions establish advertised offer, not independently audited quality. All dishes arrays remain empty to avoid creating unsupported links to the Odia dish directory. No publication, messages, bookings or calls made.
